From Tokyo.name: From Tokyo
From Tokyo.description:
🗼 You grew up in Tokyo: packed trains, late-night streets, TV studios and giant screens.

🚦 You learned which corners to avoid.
📸 You know how to act when a camera turns your way.

📈 Grants: Streetwise +5, Media Presence +5
From Tokyo.traitNarrativeEffects: Grew up in Tokyo. How Tokyo treats them: as a local; they move fast, know places tourists never find and hear rumors before the news. How Musutafu treats them: as a city person, quicker and more guarded; some find them aloof or showy; Musutafu feels small and quiet at first. Who they know: school friends citywide, a former part-time employer, someone in media or advertising, night-street faces they'd rather not owe; the narrator may name one as an original character when a Tokyo contact helps. Local knowledge: rush-hour rail, which districts are safe at night, entertainment streets of scouts, barkers and brokers, hero-goods stores, TV studios, giant screens of hero rankings and villain news; they have seen pros fight villains live on air and a few in person. Speech: standard TV Japanese; from the old downtown wards, they may soften 'hi' to 'shi' when relaxed. Habits: bag in front on crowded trains, ignore street scouts, expect strangers to mind their own business.
